description: Electricity generation plants is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Cambodia. This dataset shows the 17 locations of electricity generation plants in 4 categories: hydropower plants, heavy fuel power plants, coal plants and plants using wood and other biomass which are in operation dispersed in Cambodia according to the annual report compiled by the Electricity Authority of Cambodia in 2017. Coverage: Cambodia. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Cambodia. Its tags are Non-renewable energy production, Renewable energy production, SDG7 Affordable and Clean Energy. It offers 9 resource(s) in csv, db_table, jpeg, shp, sqlite. The portal shows 2021-06-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
